ei.title: Coupons as Tools for Saving Mental Energy
ei.subject: 6월_2026 고2 모의고사
ei.lesson: Coupons as Tools for Saving Mental Energy

fullPassage: The renowned British philosopher Alfred North Whitehead asserted that "civilization advances by extending the number of operations we can perform without thinking about them." Take, for example, the "advance" offered to civilization by the discount coupon, which allows consumers to assume that they will receive a reduced purchase price by presenting the coupon. The extent to which we have learned to operate mechanically on that assumption is illustrated in the experience of one automobile-tire company. Mailed-out coupons that — because of a printing error — offered no savings to recipients produced just as much customer response as did error-free coupons that offered substantial savings. The obvious but instructive point here is that we expect discount coupons to do double duty. Not only do we expect them to save us money, we also expect them to save us the time and mental energy required to think about how to do it. In today's world, we need the first advantage to handle pocketbook strain; but we need the second advantage to handle something potentially more important — brain strain.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.analysis: 빈칸 뒤에는 'more important(더 중요한)'라는 형용사가 있어요. 형용사를 꾸며 정도를 나타내는 말은 부사예요. 그래서 형용사 potential(잠재적인)을 부사 potentially(잠재적으로)로 바꿔 'potentially more important(잠재적으로 더 중요한)'로 써요.
det.tip: potential(잠재적인, 형용사) → potentially(잠재적으로, 부사). 형용사를 꾸미면 부사

questions.passage: The renowned British philosopher Alfred North Whitehead asserted that "civilization advances by extending the number of operations we can perform without thinking about them." Take, for example, the "advance" offered to civilization by the discount coupon, which allows consumers to assume that they will receive a reduced purchase price by presenting the coupon. The extent to which we have learned to operate mechanically on that assumption is illustrated in the experience of one automobile-tire company. Mailed-out coupons that — because of a printing error — offered no savings to recipients produced just as much customer response as did error-free coupons that offered substantial savings. The obvious but instructive point here is that we expect discount coupons to do __________. Not only do we expect them to save us money, we also expect them to save us the time and mental energy required to think about how to do it. In today's world, we need the first advantage to handle pocketbook strain; but we need the second advantage to handle something potentially more important — brain strain.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 우리는 할인 쿠폰이 ____을 하기를 기대한다 → 이중의 역할(double duty)
det.analysis:
빈칸 뒤에서 쿠폰이 '돈을 절약'해주고 '시간과 정신적 에너지도 절약'해준다고 두 가지 역할을 말해요.

❌ ① 단순한 역할: 두 가지 역할을 말하므로 '단순'이 아님
✅ ② 이중의 역할: double duty(두 가지 임무) ← 정답
❌ ③ 제한된 기능: 제한이 아닌 이중 역할
❌ ④ 부정적 효과: 부정적 내용이 아님
det.tip: double duty = 이중 역할, 두 가지 임무

questions.passage: The renowned British philosopher Alfred North Whitehead asserted that "civilization advances by extending the number of operations we can perform without thinking about them." Take, for example, the "advance" offered to civilization by the discount coupon, which allows consumers to assume that they will receive a reduced purchase price by presenting the coupon. The extent to which we have learned to operate mechanically on that assumption is illustrated in the experience of one automobile-tire company. Mailed-out coupons that — because of a printing error — offered no savings to recipients produced just as much customer response as did error-free coupons that offered substantial savings. The obvious but instructive point here is that we expect discount coupons to do double duty. Not only do we expect them to save us money, we also expect them to save us the time and mental energy required to think about how to do it. In today's world, we need the first advantage to handle pocketbook strain; but we need the second advantage to handle something potentially more important — __________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 두 번째 이점은 더 중요할 수 있는 ____을 다루기 위해 필요하다 → 정신적 부담(brain strain)
det.analysis:
빈칸 앞에서 첫 번째 이점은 'pocketbook strain(지갑 부담, 즉 경제적 부담)'을 다루고, 두 번째 이점은 더 중요한 무언가를 다룬다고 해요. 돈이 아니라 '생각하는 수고'를 덜어주는 것이므로 두뇌의 부담이에요.

❌ ① 경제적 압박: pocketbook strain은 첫 번째 이점의 몫
❌ ② 시간적 여유: 부담이지 여유가 아님
❌ ③ 물리적 피로: 물리적이 아닌 정신적
✅ ④ 정신적 부담: brain strain(두뇌 부담) ← 정답
det.tip: brain strain = 두뇌 부담, 정신적 부담 (↔ pocketbook strain 경제적 부담)
